messages:
maya: FYI customer ACME hitting a lot of 429s for embeddings since ~09:12 UTC. Console shows ~80% quota remaining for their token bucket. Escalating.

maya: stacktrace from their request: `enforcer:rate_limited: customer_id=acme-123, token=acme-key-9` — they say UI shows available units.

priya: ugh. any quick repro or request IDs?

maya: forwarded their request-id: `req_20260317_acme_9812`. They attached a screenshot of console quota panel showing "available: 4.2M" and the enforcer trace with 429s.

samir: tagging @josh for infra/metrics. can we compare what enforcer sees vs what rollup backend has for that customer?

josh: pulling live counts. metrics-bot, can you dump the last 15m token counts for acme-123 from enforcer vs rollup?

metrics-bot: enforcer_count_last_15m=1,122,334
metrics-bot: rollup_count_last_15m= 17,412

josh: whoa that's a big delta. enforcement is using streaming raw events (approx realtime). rollup job (used by the Console) is showing much lower numbers.

josh: looking at ingestion logs around the time of a deploy at 08:58 UTC. I see a schema migration was deployed in ingest-service yesterday night that moves model tag from `model.name` -> `model_id` and added an event_version=2.

josh: rollup service code filters/aggregates by `model.name` (old key). new events now carry `model_id` only, so rollup is dropping them by filter. enforcer reads from raw topic and uses whichever tag is present, so it still counts them.

maya: that would explain console undercounting and customers seeing 429s. any quick proof?

josh: yes. sample from kafka (raw messages):
```
{"event_version":2,"customer_id":"acme-123","tokens":532,"model_id":"redwood/falcon-8b"}
{"event_version":1,"customer_id":"acme-123","tokens":128,"model.name":"redwood/falcon-8b"}
```
And rollup debug logs show: `skip event: missing model.name` at high volume after 08:58:02 UTC.

priya: that migration was intended to be backward compatible. looks like the mapping for rollup wasn't included. my bad — release note missed it.

samir: mitigation options: 1) hotfix rollup to accept `model_id` OR 2) emit compat field `model.name` in ingest-service again OR 3) temporarily route traffic to older ingest. Which is fastest?

josh: quickest is a small patch in rollup: fallback to `model_id` when `model.name` is missing. I have a branch. Can push a hotfix canary to small subset of rollup workers.

deploy-bot: deploy pipeline queued for rollup/hotfix branch. canary target: 10% workers in eu-west-1. ETA ~12m if approvals OK.

maya: customer needs immediate relief — any way to throttle enforcement while we fix?

samir: we can add a temporary upstream rule to broaden quota windows for acme-123 (raise soft limit) but that skirts enforcement guarantees. prefer fixing metric mapping.

josh: will push hotfix now. patch diff (snippet):
```
- model_name = event.get('model.name')
+ model_name = event.get('model.name') or event.get('model_id')
```
This preserves older behavior.

josh: starting canary deploy now. monitoring -> linking token counts post-deploy.

metrics-bot: canary live. after 3m: rollup_count_last_15m (canary workers)= 1,087,900 -> matches enforcer closely.

maya: customer confirmed rate errors dropped for new requests at 09:34 UTC. They still see a few failures but much improved.

priya: we should add automated schema compatibility tests and update release checklist to include rollup/console as downstream consumers. Filing followup doc.

josh: filing a short postmortem in #incidents once stabilized. initial root cause = schema field rename without rollup compatibility.

samir: action items:
- josh: merge hotfix to main and promote full rollout (in 30m)
- ingest-team: re-add compat emission for next deploy and add contract tests
- product/priya: update release checklist + notify affected customers (ACME)
- ops: consider temporary alerts when enforcer vs rollup delta > 20% for a customer

maya: thanks all. I'll keep the customer updated and close the escalation after full rollout. :thumbsup:

deploy-bot: rollup full rollout complete at 09:52 UTC. all workers running hotfix.

metrics-bot: post-rollout numbers: enforcer_last_60m=4,500,102; rollup_last_60m=4,494,880 (delta ~0.12%).

maya: closing thread, will add notes to the ticket.

josh: adding a tiny log line to make missing-key errors obvious in future.

priya: created release checklist PR `#312` and contract tests ticket `#2145`.

samir: nice runbook fix.
